eyebrow: Managing many accounts as one unit

steps.label: Management account
steps.sub: creates/invites member accounts, applies org-wide policy

steps.label: Organizational Units (OUs)
steps.sub: folders of accounts, can nest; policies apply to everything underneath

steps.label: One guardrail, not one per account
steps.sub: attach a policy at the OU, it reaches every account inside it

caption: NotAction excludes global services; Condition denies everything requested outside the approved regions.
Unconditional deny at the OU level — even AdministratorAccess cannot override it.

steps.label: Never a grant
steps.sub: an SCP can't be the reason a request succeeds

steps.label: A ceiling, not a floor
steps.sub: the actual Allow still has to come from IAM inside the account

steps.label: Both must agree
steps.sub: IAM and every applicable SCP have to allow it for a request to succeed
